title: mtls_auth
description: Authenticates a consumer by client certificate. Revocation is not checked (spec §9.4).

ca_certificates.description: CA certificates a client's chain must lead to, by name or id.

consumer_by.description: Which value of the certificate is matched against mtls credentials. fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the certificate, lower-case hex.

skip_consumer_lookup.description: Accept any certificate from a trusted CA without naming a consumer.

anonymous.description: A consumer name to run as when no certificate is presented.
